services.name: Tasting Room
services.desc: Enjoy an elevated tasting featuring a selection of our Pinot Noirs. Our wine team will guide you through a flight of five of our award-winning Pinot Noirs, comparing vintages and different blocks within the estate. 90 minute experience $50 per guest - $20 per

services.name: ATV Tour and Tasting
services.desc: Ride along and explore 120 acres of vineyards and Eden Rift’s most picturesque viewpoints on a guided tour in our Polaris ATV. Enjoy a tasting of wines in the vineyards they were grown while enjoying Cienega Valley's views. Groups of 2-4 guests. 120 minute experience $100 per guest - $75 per member Book

explain.meaning: A four-wheeled off-road quad you ride like a motorbike.

services.name: Helicopter Tour and Tasting
services.desc: Named by 7x7 Bay Area as "The Most Exciting Wine Tasting In California", we partnered with Specialized Helicopters to bring you the ultimate wine tasting and helicopter tour of Eden Rift. You will land on our private heli pad and be picked up by a ATV vehicle and driven around the vineyards while tasting a flight.

quotes.text: We are thrilled to be named as one of the world's Top 100 Wineries. To be included with our peers in this list is humbling for a brand as relatively young as ours, but absolutely indicative of where we believe we are taking it.
